case.title: Dragging to another technician changes the lead, Unassigned clears it
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Golf Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Golf Co").
  • Work orders (all Approved): lead Ana — Alpha Co; no lead — Golf Co.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved: Alpha Co led by Ana, Golf Co with no lead (Unassigned). On the Schedule neither has a shift. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Drag the Alpha Co card from Ana's column into Ben's column and release.
  5. Click the Alpha Co card to open the work order and read its Lead Technician, then go back with the browser Back button.
  6. Drag the Alpha Co card from Ben's column into the Unassigned column and release.
  7. Open the Alpha Co work order again, read Lead Technician, then go back.
  8. Drag the Golf Co card from the Unassigned column into Cal's column and release.
  9. Open the Golf Co work order, read Lead Technician, then go back.
  10. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  11. Drag the Golf Co row from Cal's group into Ana's group and release, then open it and read Lead Technician.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After step 4 the card sits in Ben's column and a message naming the work order and Ben appears, with an Undo button (e.g. "S1-801 assigned to ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", with Alpha Co's own number). It closes by itself after about 5 seconds while the pointer is not over it.
  • Step 5: the work order page shows Lead Technician Ben Bravo.
  • After step 6 the card sits in Unassigned and the message "<Alpha Co's number> moved to Unassigned" appears (e.g. "S1-801 moved to Unassigned"), with an Undo button.
  • Step 7: the work order page shows no lead technician.
  • Steps 8 and 9: the Golf Co card moved into Cal's column and its work order page shows Lead Technician Cal Charlie.
  • Step 11: in Tech View the row moves to Ana's group and the work order page shows Lead Technician Ana Alpha.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S9-R6, S9-R7, S4-R5, S4-R16, read 19 Oct 2026.

Known problem (SV-11524, open; seen on staging by the designer on 19 Oct 2026): the message after a lead change reads "Lead technician updated" (or "Lead technician removed") and has no Undo button. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R6: “Between-technician moves reassign the lead under Story 4.”
  • S9-R7: “Moving a work order to Unassigned removes its lead; moving it out assigns the destination lead.”
  • S4-R5: “After a successful lead change on Board View or Tech View, whether by drag, the dialog or Unassign, show the design’s toast (white, with the check icon) with an Undo button. It reads “{work order number} assigned to {technician name}”; “{work order number} lead technician set to {technician name}” when the new lead was already the technician on at least one of the work order’s lines; or “{work order number} moved to Unassigned” after removing the lead. Examples: “S1-357 assigned to Esther Howard”, “S1-702 lead technician set to Ralph Edwards”, “S1-352 moved to Unassigned”. This replaces the standard success toast for these messages only.”
  • S4-R16: “The lead-change toast closes on its own after 5 seconds (5,000 ms) while it carries the Undo button, and after 2.6 seconds (2,600 ms) without one, as in the design; it stays open while the pointer is over it, and closes when Undo is clicked. The “Assignment undone” toast (S4-R32) closes after 2.6 seconds. Other success toasts dismiss automatically, as today.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11524)

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Assign lead technician > click the technician; it is assigned at once.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").

Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Lead Change" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved: Alpha Co led by Ana, Golf Co with no lead (Unassigned).
